role_subclass_contract.rule: node instances can only register operators and consume configs allowed by their role subclass; operator kind and config must both validate

node_numbering.rule: node_id encodes topological order (NN) and semantic function (SemanticName); both are contract and immutable after publication

semantics.sse_in_sse_out_coupling: forbidden; SSE is transport boundary only
semantics.chat_process: supernode group with entry/exit hooks for servertool and cross-cutting processing

semantics.flow: provider_sse -> inbound -> chat_process(group) -> outbound -> client_sse -> server
semantics.sse_in_sse_out_coupling: forbidden; provider SSE must not pipe directly to client SSE
semantics.chat_process: supernode group with continuation save, response governance, tool harvest, and entry/exit hooks for servertool
semantics.immutable_interval: resp_chatprocess save -> next req_chatprocess restore; no semantic transformation in between
semantics.terminal: V4ServerRespOutbound06ClientFrame is the single success terminal

rules: entry hooks run before operator in position order
exit hooks run after operator in position order
hooks are not operators and cannot create a second lifecycle or shortcut nodes
hooks must be machine declared; undeclared hooks cannot execute
control in/out requires ControlRecord
debug/snapshot subscriptions are read-only
hook failure enters the error chain explicitly; no fallback

servertool_exception.rule: servertool uses control_only hooks at chat process group entry/exit

rules: group external interface equals NodeInstance interface
exactly one entry_node and one exit_node
external data_in equals entry node data_in; external data_out equals exit node data_out
parent chain only connects to group entry/exit; internal nodes are not visible to parent
group is not a second lifecycle; errors still enter parent error chain
internal implementation is replaceable while external interface is unchanged
expansion must be semantically equivalent

chain_must_have: explicit error path into error chain

data_flow.rule: only adjacent nodes; resources must be data-axis; one data_in and one data_out per node

information_flow.rule: only adjacent nodes on data_plane=false chains (config/lifecycle/diagnostic); resources must be information-axis; no control or data resource may travel an information edge

control_flow.rule: record_required must be true; scope isolation enforced; control never enters data axis; release owned by registering node

debug_subscription.rule: read_only must be true; no payload; no decision influence

error_intake.rule: any node/operator/hook error enters v4.control.error_center as typed error facts plus payload hash and typed context; the center classifies and audits only; route decision belongs to v4.control.route_exit; original payload is immutable across switch/cooldown/reroute

error_center.intake: typed error facts from any node/operator/hook via error_intake edge; payload_hash_and_typed_context_only
error_center.output: classified error facts consumed by v4.control.route_exit decision owner
error_center.rule: error center never makes routing decisions; VR owns the decision using classified error facts and the original request payload reference

route_exit.rule: switch/cooldown/reroute are all decisions emitted from this exit and remain inside the same request payload cycle

payload_cycle.success_terminal: response entered client; the next request begins a new cycle
payload_cycle.error_terminal: error terminal only; switch/cooldown/reroute are merged into the same cycle
payload_cycle.original_payload: immutable within a cycle; retries re-execute the same original payload

rules: diagnostic-only; never affects business result, control decision, or payload
every live switch is recorded in the immutable audit ledger
switch scope is per module/node and per closed-loop request scope
dry_run is supported per module with declared chain entry/exit; default is the full request or response chain
dry-run input is the correct payload fixture; no real provider call
switch/dry-run state never enters provider wire, client wire, payload, MetadataCenter, or error chain

protocol_same_stage_rule.rule: different protocols share the same node instance and role subclass; each protocol registers an operator on that slot
protocol_same_stage_rule.wiring_selection: exactly one active operator per node instance per compiled manifest

verification_rules: all edge from/to must exist in declared nodes
data edges must be adjacent in chain_version
data edge resources must belong to data axis
control edge resources must belong to control axis
control edge record_required must be true
information edges are only valid on data_plane=false chains and must carry information-axis resources only
config chain is fixed: V4Config01AuthoringFileSource -> V4Config02AuthoringParsed -> V4Config03SchemaValidated -> V4Config04ResourceRegistryBuilt -> V4Config05ManifestPublished
debug subscription edges must be read_only
error_intake edges must target v4.control.error_center, carry payload_hash and typed_context, and have record_required true
error center must not own route decisions; route decisions must exit via v4.control.route_exit owned by the router
switch/cooldown/reroute must remain inside the same payload cycle with the original request payload immutable
module debug switch edges are diagnostic-only and cannot touch mainline, payload, MetadataCenter, or error chain
dry-run chains must declare entry/exit or default to the full request/response chain with a correct payload fixture
forbidden edges cannot be added
every code-level conversion/subscription/control operation must resolve to a declared edge
every node is a class with role subclass binding
group external interface equals NodeInstance interface
every group has exactly one entry and one exit
parent chain cannot connect to group internal nodes
every chain has single entry and single terminal
every published node/group/chain has its standard test surface
v4 hub request chain is fixed: server -> sse_in -> inbound -> chat_process(group) -> outbound -> compat -> provider_sse_out
v4 hub response chain is the request chain mirror: provider_sse_in -> inbound -> chat_process(group) -> outbound -> client_sse_out -> server
continuation save occurs only at V4HubRespChatProcess03Governed; resp_chatprocess save -> req_chatprocess restore interval is immutable
sse is transport boundary only; internal data plane is json semantic
sse_in and sse_out cannot be directly coupled
direct and relay share the same chain; they differ only in operator selection and typed facts
every node entry/exit hook queue is machine declared and ordered
